summary.text: Joyce Fulweiler is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
She previously served in the House, representing Merrimack 3 from December 5, 2018, to December 1, 2020.

paragraphs.text: Fulweiler was first elected in the November 6, 2018 general election, finishing second of four candidates for the two Merrimack 3 seats.
During the 2019-2020 term she was assigned to the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
Fulweiler ran again in Merrimack 3 in November 2020 but finished fourth for the two seats, behind Gregory Hill, Kenna Cross and Sheena Duncan.
She was the Democratic candidate in Merrimack 2 in 2022, when incumbent Gregory Hill defeated her, and in Merrimack 25 in 2024, when James Thibault defeated her.
